slug: 2026-01-28 Madagascar digital ID pilot kicks off, testing infrastructure ahead of nationwide rollout

systems.platform: IriTech IriAegis-BK iris scanner as official hardware; face, iris and fingerprint capture
systems.owner: Government of Madagascar under the World Bank-funded PRODIGY; integration with ministries through the national interoperability system overseen by the Digital Governance Unit
systems.tiers: pilot from 27 January 2026, mainly in the district of Antsimondrano; national rollout expected from April 2026, more than 12 million citizens targeted

note: Identity enrolment pilot only; no civil registration system is described.
